title: Firm positionality and strategic communication: analyzing the value of informativeness for managers
core_idea: The study investigates how price informativeness moderates the relationship between brand value and firm positionality, arguing that its effects extend beyond direct market impacts to influence brand–firm dynamics and therefore shape firms' strategic positioning and communication choices.
tldr: Explores price informativeness as a moderator of the brand value–firm positionality relationship to guide firms' strategic positioning and communication.
